parameters.description:
`msg-to-fcm` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Firebase Cloud Messaging destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Firebase Cloud Messaging destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Firebase Cloud Messaging destinations bound per enrollment.

Create (or open) your project in the Firebase console, then click the gear icon next to the project name and go to Project Settings → Cloud Messaging to copy the legacy Server key into FCM_APIKEY. Separately, register your app with the Firebase Cloud Messaging SDK to obtain a per-device registration token, or use a topic name if you're broadcasting instead of targeting one device, and set that value as FCM_TO.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment FCM destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Firebase Cloud Messaging
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Firebase Cloud Messaging destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Firebase Cloud Messaging apikey

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's FCM_TO value (same format as FCM_TO)
